description: Shows Agent Fusion Router's savings estimates for Claude Code and Codex in the status bar, at API list prices.
config.period: The period the status bar covers: today (since local midnight), the last 7 days, or the last 30 days.
config.refreshMinutes: How often to re-read the records, in minutes. Only files that changed are read again.
config.claudeLogDir: The Claude Code plugin's log folder. Empty: ~/.agent-fusion-router/logs. A WSL folder can be named as \\wsl$\<distro>\home\<user>\.agent-fusion-router\logs.
config.codexHome: Codex's data folder. Empty: CODEX_HOME, else ~/.codex. A WSL folder can be named as \\wsl$\<distro>\home\<user>\.codex.
config.codexStandardModel: Simulate ordinary Codex work on this model (for example sol). Empty keeps each turn's own model, the router's default.
